comment: Extremely kind & caring. Will walk you through everything and listen to class needs. There are weekly quizzes, which can be arduous, but if you do the weekly assignments, then they aren't that bad. She drops your worst HW and quiz grades, which is awesome. Tests are pretty hard, but if you give it like two solid days of studying you'll be fine.
Engaging and well-taught course. I very much enjoyed it. She is a super kind professor and she knows the subject inside out. very organized. I learnt a lot. Strongly recommend the class.

Dr Mago is a terrific teacher, very easy to talk to and works hard to make the class engaging. She records her lectures, so you won't fall behind if you miss a class. She definitely seeks to challenge her students so don't expect an easy A but an A is definitely feasible. Grade was exam heavy but also partially homeworks + a final project.

Fabulous professor! She is so kind and so knowledgeable. She conveys her passion for the subject in every class. Yes! we do a lot of models but she alaways draws the connection to the real world, so it is not doing calculus for the sake of it. I enjoyed almost every topic we covered in class. She is very thorough and precise in her lectures.
Boring and monotonous, lectures were painful.
Great class! Wonderful, caring professor. I learnt a lot.

Great course! One of the best professors I had at UR. She is kind and caring, and so knowledgeable and passionate about IO. The course is amazing, and she actually teaches it. You can't miss a class because there is no textbook but you will learn so much in every class. At the end of the course, you will never ever look at a price tag the same way.
SHE IS AWESOME!

I took Micro with Mehkari and I know everyone loves him. I like him too. But I love Mago. She is so caring and kind. She knows her stuff and class is well organized. The chapter handouts are impeccable. There is HW after every class, 2 midterms & final, weekly quizzes and group project - by no means an easy class. But my favorite from freshman year

Genuinely one of the most caring profs ever. She also gives out packets so you don't even need to take notes, so don't zone out during the lecture or you'll be lost when the midterms/final roll around. Overall very easy.

Overall speed/content of the class is manageable+Dr. Mago did a good job explaining the material. Notes/slides/handouts were very disorganized and made it challenging to study for exams. About half the grade is group work and if you don't work well with your group your grade will suffer. Not receptive of feedback on the course even when she asked.

One of the best professors at UR! I learnt so much from the course. Taylor Swift and her connection to anti-trust policies, why firms bundle their products, price discrimination are few of my favorite topics. It is a great course and she is great at teaching it.

Generally good teacher, but needs to consolidate her notes because they are everywhere (handouts, written notes, stuff she says in class, powerpoints....) The decision to have one midterm is questionable. She can nitpicky sometimes.

Class notes were very scattered between handouts and paper notes so gathering study material for exams was confusing. Tests were pretty similar to homework and class problems. Never knew anyone's overall grade in the class and if you asked her she wouldn't calculate it. Also asked students for feedback mid-semester and didn't listen to any of it
Dr. Mago is the best teacher I have had at UR. I have taken all 3 courses that she has taught - Macro, Game Theory and IO. I will miss her. Thanks Mago!

Dr. Mago is awesome! She integrated the class material with real-world examples well, and I learned a lot from this class. I have to note how much effort she made in helping us understand the materials. Highly recommend her to everyone!

Economics is not my favorite subject but Mago brings it to life. It has been so fun to see how class material relates to the real world. The class is so well structured and organized  - daily assignments, weekly quizzes and awesome handouts - that you really have to try to fall behind in class. She is incredibly kind and fair. I recommend her!

She is the best Macro teacher. She gives detailed handouts for every chapter so you don't have to buy a textbook. There is an online assignment after every class and a quiz every week. That seems a lot but it keeps you on track. She does a great job relating the class material to real world events. I learnt so much from the course. Thanks Mago.
She is the BEST! You will learn a lot from the class. The class is lecture heavy but she is great at it. Very accessible outside class.

Delayed emails, even if you care about the course and GPA , if you miss class more than once she automatically assumes you to be a bad kid. Not easy to get in her good graces, and very quick to assume what "type" of person you are. Ive had only positive experiences w my teachers here but she is one person who I would prefer to have not taken.
Very good professor but also very confused in her classes. Her questions in papers are sometimes misphrased and confusing.

Prof. Mago is great. Her lectures are not boring at all, she does a good job at explaining things. During class, she goes over the note packet which includes practice questions. For homework, everything comes out of the note packet for that chapter. The test questions are very similar to the homework questions. She is always happy to help!

She truly tries to make things better for the ones who care. There will be assignments after every class but they are not that bad. She is always there to help when needed and she is accessible during office hours. Pay attention to her lectures and everything will be okay!

She gives you 4 hours of homework (basically just several quizzes) every weekend and 2 hours of quizzes/homeworks during the week. Also totally unwilling to accept our feedback that this was a really unfair and stress-inducing way to go about structuring an online class during a global pandemic

Dr. Mago will pretend to care about your mental health and will say she wants to meet if you have any questions. But then when you ask to meet she wont answer your emails! She gives an insane amount of homework and her online tests are truly impossible.
Excellent!
Dr Mago is a caring, smart, passionate, organized teacher. Her grading is clear. The material is all organized in outlines and she truly is there for all the students.

Mago's passion for industrial organization combined with discussions of its real world applications made the class really interesting. The midterm and final were tough, but that's the case in most upper level econ classes.

LOVE her and the class. Gives out all material, very straight forward/organized. Group HW then quiz based on it with fun final project at end. Tests are LONG/hard/high percent but fair. Makes material interesting. Accessible outside class. You get out what you put in. Great Econ elective, wish there was a higher level game theory class, shes great!

An absolutely horrible teacher. Do not take her, there are so many better Macro teachers at this school. Her test are ridiculous and a third of the test are based on true and false that is horribly worded. Overall, reading a textbook would provide you with more knowledge and information than she does.

Very nice professor. Gives out packets of notes before each chapter where you just fill in the blanks. Quizzes every Monday, but if you pay attention they're not bad. On the tests, the questions are tricky, so be prepared to really study the packets beforehand.
Super interesting and unique class, and she makes it fun for students. Her teaching is thorough without being confusing or overbearing. She's definitely work taking.
One of the most boring classes I have taken in a while. Not a lot of hw. Tests are moderately difficult, but if you do the homework and study, they are not too bad.
She's great! Very helpful. Good handouts, almost no homework and fair grader. I would definitely take her class again.

I read the reviews of Mago on here and boy are they wrong. By far my least favorite teacher here. Trick questions on testsquizzes. Unclear lectures. Does not teach, but rather reads you the information needed. Graded online homework that is unexpectedly difficult. If you can avoid her class, do it. There are much bester Macro teachers at Richmond.

The one to take for Macro. You have to go to most of the classes (don't miss more than 3-4), but she teaches well and the class is easy so it's well worth it. A- but would've had the A if I didn't tank the first test, which was actually very easy. My only worry is that we did different material from other classes so I might be behind moving forward

I got good initial vibes from Mago but those intuitions went sour. She LOVES calling people out in class, even if you're not doing anything, which is really unprofessional. She asks a lot of trick questions, watch wording carefully. Online homework is annoying. Responds to emails quickly, good office hours. Good, but better options for 102 at UR.
She tries really hard to get her students to understand the concepts. Really useful handouts and weekly quizzes which are pretty fair. Little to no homework and overall fair tests.

Really great professor.  Her class got boring some classes but I also learned a lot.  Weekly quizzes so always have to be reviewing class materials but gives handouts.  Seemed very approachable and helped a great deal when I went to her office hours a couple of times.  Would definitely take another class of hers.

I absolutely loved her!! I would totally recommend her. She's a fair and easy grader. Class can get kind of boring but she definitely goes out of her way to make sure student's understand. Extremely helpful and understanding. There are weekly quizzes but they are easy, just read the handouts before class.
Take this professor. She's really nice, friendly, and really helpful. She's not hard at all.
Professor Mago is an amazing professor.  Gives out packets that you fill in during class.  Two midterms and a final as well as weekly quizzes, but study the packets and it's a breeze.

Professor Mago is an AMAZING teacher. She is so cute and really does want all of her students to do well and gets upset when they don't.  She gives weekly quizzes, but she is pretty clear about what will be on them and she drops your two lowest grades from them.  I would definitely recommend taking her!!
